These are some photographs I have taken of curb communiqués that have caught
my eye while walking and cycling around Portland. Some are political. Some are
jokes. Some are both. Some I agree with. Some I definitely don't. Some I can't
make heads or tails of. But maybe they will resonate with you.

They are free to share and use, as long as you credit: 'Photograph by
Nathaniel St. Clair, CounterPunch - [CC BY
4.0′](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"A budget is a statement of values."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"No airbags. We die like real men."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"Developer domination unjust. Overpopulation unwise. Liberal fascism built
upon lies."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"I wanna be higher than the cost of living."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"Bitch, don't kill my vibe."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"White lives matter. Time to take a stand."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

"Good night, white pride."



![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-

![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
